info.name: Central Archive - 07 Backend Functional Regression
info.description: Companion to BACKEND_FUNCTIONAL_AUDIT.md. Run only against a test/staging server. Set username/password for an existing system_admin or auditor with appropriate clearance. The collection performs login/read/error-contract checks only: it does not create, approve, delete or import archive data. CI evidence comes from the Java regression suites, not from a claim that this collection was executed. Rejection requests use rejection_reason; responses use data.rejectionReason, while data.reviewNotes remains the correction instruction.

exec: pm.test('Queue contains only latest projects under review', () => { const rows = pm.response.json().data.data; rows.forEach(row => { pm.expect(row.status).to.eql('UNDER_REVIEW'); pm.expect(row.isLatestVersion).to.eql(true); }); });

pm.test('Known submission dates are ordered before unknown dates', () => { let last = -Infinity, seenNull = false; for (const row of pm.response.json().data.data) { if (row.submittedAt == null) { seenNull = true; continue; } pm.expect(seenNull).to.eql(false); const date = Date.parse(row.submittedAt); pm.expect(Number.isFinite(date)).to.eql(true); pm.expect(date).to.be.at.least(last); last = date; } });

item.name: Enums - audit and dashboard are distinct additive vocabularies

exec: pm.test('New sort field and dashboard keys exist', () => { const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.projectSortFields).to.include('submittedAt'); pm.expect(d.dashboardAction).to.include('FILE_UPLOADED'); pm.expect(d.dashboardEntityType).to.include('PACKAGE'); pm.expect(d.auditAction).to.include('READ'); pm.expect(d.auditEntityType).to.include('Project'); });
